certifications.summary: Practical exam on finding and exploiting vulnerabilities in AI and ML systems, including adversarial ML, prompt injection and LLM application attacks, with a written report. Requires completing the AI Red Teamer job-role path.

certifications.name: HTB Certified Detection Engineering Principal (CDEP)
certifications.summary: Practical exam on turning observed adversary behaviour into detection logic across Windows and Linux telemetry, with a report mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Requires completing the Detection Engineer job-role path.

certifications.name: Practical SOC Analyst Associate (PSAA)
certifications.summary: Associate-level practical exam on security operations and incident investigation at Tier 1 and Tier 2 level, with a written report. Formerly the Practical Junior Security Analyst (PJSA); does not expire.

certifications.name: Practical Web Pentest Professional (PWPP)
certifications.summary: Professional-level practical web application penetration test covering issues such as NoSQL injection, race conditions, SSRF and template injection, with a written report. Does not expire.

certifications.name: Practical Malware Research Professional (PMRP)
certifications.summary: Practical exam on malware analysis and triage that requires an analysis report and detection rules for the samples. Formerly the Practical Junior Malware Researcher (PJMR); does not expire.

certifications.name: Practical AI Pentest Associate (PAPA)
certifications.summary: Associate-level practical exam on exploiting an agentic AI application, with a written report. Does not expire.

certifications.name: Practical IoT Pentest Associate (PIPA)
certifications.summary: Associate-level practical review of an embedded Linux IoT device's firmware and hardware captures, with a written report. Formerly the Practical Junior IoT Tester (PJIT); does not expire.

certifications.name: GIAC Cloud Forensics Responder (GCFR)
certifications.summary: Covers incident investigation across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Kubernetes. Exam has 82 questions in three hours.

certifications.name: GIAC Cloud Security Automation (GCSA)
certifications.summary: Covers the cloud-native toolchain, DevSecOps practice and security controls in CI/CD pipelines. Exam has 75 questions in two hours.

certifications.name: GIAC Experienced Penetration Tester (GX-PT)
certifications.summary: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive performance-based challenges in four hours covering network mapping, vulnerability identification and exploitation. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.

certifications.name: INE Certified Incident Responder (eCIR)
certifications.summary: Practical, lab-based exam on incident detection, analysis and response scenarios. The credential is valid for three years.

certifications.name: INE Certified Digital Forensics Professional (eCDFP)
certifications.summary: Scenario-based digital forensics exam covering evidence acquisition and analysis of disk, network and log artefacts. The credential is valid for three years.

certifications.name: INE Security Operations Certified Level 1 (eSOC)
certifications.summary: Entry-level defensive certification on security monitoring, alert triage, threat detection and incident response. The credential is valid for three years.

certifications.name: CREST Practitioner Security Analyst (CPSA)
certifications.summary: Entry-level closed-book multiple-choice exam of 120 questions in two hours on assessing operating systems, network services and web applications. A valid CPSA is required before sitting the CRT.

certifications.name: CREST Registered Penetration Tester (CRT)
certifications.summary: Intermediate practical exam of 2.5 hours in a provided Kali Linux environment, covering infrastructure and web application testing. Accepted by the UK NCSC CHECK scheme.

certifications.name: CREST Certified Tester - Infrastructure (CCT INF)
certifications.summary: Advanced certification with a three-hour written exam and a three-hour practical exam on network and operating system level testing. Accepted by the UK NCSC CHECK scheme.

certifications.name: Microsoft Cloud and AI Security Engineer (SC-500)
certifications.summary: Associate certification covering identity, access and governance, security for storage, databases, networking and compute, AI workloads and security posture management in Azure and hybrid environments. Replaced AZ-500 in 2026.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Professional Security Operations Engineer (PSOE)
certifications.summary: Covers detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, data management and platform operations with Google Cloud security tooling. Multiple choice exam of 50 to 60 questions.

certifications.name: CCNP Cybersecurity
certifications.summary: Professional-level security operations certification requiring the 350-201 CBRCOR core exam and one concentration exam (300-215 CBRFIR forensics and incident response, or 300-220 CBRTHD threat hunting).

certifications.name: Cisco Certificate in Ethical Hacking (Cisco EH)
certifications.summary: Certificate earned by completing the Cisco Networking Academy Ethical Hacker course and one capture the flag challenge in Cisco U. It has no traditional exam and is valid for life.

certifications.name: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Security Associate (KCSA)
certifications.summary: Entry-level multiple choice exam on Kubernetes and cloud native security fundamentals. Online and proctored, with no prerequisites.

certifications.name: Palo Alto Networks Next-Generation Firewall Engineer (NGFW Engineer)
certifications.summary: Specialist-level role-based certification for engineers who deploy and operate Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls. One of the successors to the retired PCNSE.

certifications.name: Palo Alto Networks Network Security Professional (NetSec Pro)
certifications.summary: Professional-level role-based certification covering the Palo Alto Networks network security portfolio. It sits below the specialist certifications in the Network Security track.

certifications.name: Palo Alto Networks Network Security Architect (NetSec Architect)
certifications.summary: Architect-level certification at the top of the Palo Alto Networks Network Security track, focused on designing network security architectures.

certifications.name: Palo Alto Networks Cloud Security Engineer (CloudSec Engineer)
certifications.summary: Specialist-level role-based certification in the Palo Alto Networks Cloud Security track. Successor to the retired Prisma Certified Cloud Security Engineer (PCCSE).

certifications.name: Palo Alto Networks Cloud Security Professional (CloudSec Pro)
certifications.summary: Professional-level role-based certification in the Palo Alto Networks Cloud Security track, positioned below the Cloud Security Engineer specialist certification.

certifications.name: Palo Alto Networks Security Operations Professional (SecOps Pro)
certifications.summary: Professional-level role-based certification in the Palo Alto Networks Security Operations track, the step before the XDR, XSIAM and XSOAR specialist certifications.

certifications.name: Palo Alto Networks XSIAM Engineer
certifications.summary: Specialist-level role-based certification for engineers working with Cortex XSIAM in the Palo Alto Networks Security Operations track.

certifications.name: Wireshark Certified Analyst (WCA-101)
certifications.summary: Official packet analysis certification from the Wireshark Foundation. The WCA-101 exam has 50 to 60 questions and is delivered through Kryterion.

certifications.name: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer Associate (SOA-C03)
certifications.summary: Associate certification on deploying, operating and monitoring workloads on AWS. Renamed from SysOps Administrator Associate with exam version SOA-C03 in September 2025.

certifications.name: Okta Certified Administrator (Okta Admin)
certifications.summary: Second-level Okta certification for administrators, taken after Okta Certified Professional. Valid for two years.

certifications.name: LPI Security Essentials (LPI SE)
certifications.summary: Entry-level certificate on basic IT security concepts. Exam 020-100 has 40 questions and the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: LPIC-3 Security (LPIC-3 303)
certifications.summary: Enterprise-level Linux security certification. Exam 303-300 has 60 questions and requires an active LPIC-2.

certifications.name: SailPoint Certified Identity Security Engineer (SP-ISE)
certifications.summary: SailPoint professional certification launched in February 2025. Up to 73 questions with up to 120 minutes of seat time, valid for two years.

certifications.name: Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Engineer (SCDE)
certifications.summary: Professional-level Splunk security certification above the Cybersecurity Defense Analyst. The exam has 60 multiple choice questions.

certifications.name: Blue Team Level 1 (BTL1)
certifications.summary: Junior defensive security certification assessed through a 24-hour practical incident response exam. Issued by Centri, the provider formerly named Security Blue Team.

certifications.name: Blue Team Level 2 (BTL2)
certifications.summary: Advanced defensive certification with a practical assessment of up to 72 hours and a written report that is marked by hand. Issued by Centri, the provider formerly named Security Blue Team.

certifications.name: Certified CyberDefender Level 1 (CCDL1)
certifications.summary: Entry-level SOC analyst certification with a practical exam covering alert triage, investigation and documented handover.

certifications.name: Certified CyberDefender Level 2 (CCDL2)
certifications.summary: Threat hunting and DFIR certification, formerly named CCD, assessed through a 48-hour practical exam covering disk and memory forensics, network analysis and SIEM hunting.

certifications.name: Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP)
certifications.summary: Practical web application security exam in which the candidate has four hours to compromise two deliberately vulnerable applications using Burp Suite Professional.

certifications.name: Certified AppSec Practitioner (CAP)
certifications.summary: Entry-level multiple-choice exam on application security fundamentals, with factual and scenario-based questions. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Network Pentester (CNPen)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on network penetration testing, taken online and on demand. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified AppSec Pentester (CAPen)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on web application penetration testing, taken online and on demand. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Wireless Network Administrator (CWNA)
certifications.summary: Vendor-neutral enterprise Wi-Fi administration certification with a 60-question exam. It is the required base credential for the CWNP professional-level certifications.

certifications.name: Certified Wireless Security Professional (CWSP)
certifications.summary: Vendor-neutral certification on securing enterprise Wi-Fi networks, with a 60-question exam. Candidates must hold a current CWNA credential.

certifications.name: PECB Certified ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer (ISO 27001 LI)
certifications.summary: Certification for professionals who establish, implement and maintain an information security management system based on ISO/IEC 27001. Valid for three years with maintenance fees.

certifications.name: PECB Certified ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor (ISO 27001 LA)
certifications.summary: Certification for professionals who plan and perform audits of information security management systems against ISO/IEC 27001. Valid for three years with maintenance fees.

certifications.name: HashiCorp Certified: Vault Associate
certifications.summary: One-hour online proctored multiple-choice exam on HashiCorp Vault fundamentals, including secrets management, authentication methods and policies.

certifications.name: GitHub Advanced Security (GH-500)
certifications.summary: Exam GH-500 on using GitHub Advanced Security to secure code, secrets and dependencies, covering secret protection, supply chain security and code scanning with CodeQL.

certifications.name: Linux Foundation Certified System Administrator (LFCS)
certifications.summary: Online proctored performance-based exam in which candidates solve Linux system administration tasks from the command line.

certifications.name: Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP)
certifications.summary: Practical exam of five challenges to be solved in six hours, followed by 24 hours to submit a report, covering security automation in CI/CD pipelines. Lifetime credential.

certifications.name: Certified Cloud Native Security Expert (CCNSE)
certifications.summary: Practical exam of five challenges in a six-hour window, followed by 24 hours to submit a report, covering container and Kubernetes security. Lifetime credential.

certifications.name: Certified AI Security Professional (CAISP)
certifications.summary: Practical exam of five challenges in six hours, followed by 24 hours to submit a report, covering attacks on and defences for AI and LLM systems. Lifetime credential.

certifications.name: SABSA Chartered Security Architect, Foundation Certificate (SCF)
certifications.summary: Foundation level of the SABSA enterprise security architecture framework. Two modules (F1 and F2) of 48 multiple-choice questions and 60 minutes each, with a 75% pass mark per module.

certifications.name: Open FAIR 2 Foundation
certifications.summary: Knowledge-based certification on the Open FAIR body of knowledge for quantitative information risk analysis.

certifications.name: Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP)
certifications.summary: Business continuity credential requiring more than two years of experience, five subject-area essays with references and a pass of at least 75% on the DRI Qualifying Examination.

certifications.name: PCI Professional (PCIP)
certifications.summary: Individual qualification from the PCI Security Standards Council on the PCI DSS. Closed-book exam of 75 multiple-choice questions, with requalification every three years.

certifications.name: CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)
certifications.summary: 90-minute, 60-question exam on administering the CrowdStrike Falcon platform. Valid for three years.

certifications.name: CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder (CCFR)
certifications.summary: 90-minute, 60-question exam on triaging and responding to detections in the CrowdStrike Falcon platform. Valid for three years.

certifications.name: CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Hunter (CCFH)
certifications.summary: 90-minute, 60-question exam on threat hunting with CrowdStrike Falcon telemetry and queries. Valid for three years.

certifications.name: Certified Forensic Computer Examiner (CFCE)
certifications.summary: Two-phase digital forensics certification: a peer review of four practical problems, then a hard drive practical and a 100-question knowledge test. External candidates must show 72 hours of relevant training.

certifications.name: Certified Computer Examiner (CCE)
certifications.summary: Digital forensics certification offered by ISFCE since 2003. Applicants need approved training and 18 months of verifiable professional experience for the full designation.

certifications.name: Chainalysis Certified Investigator (CCI)
certifications.summary: Investigator-track credential from Chainalysis Academy on tracing cryptocurrency transactions with Chainalysis tools. Chainalysis Digital Asset Fundamentals is a required prerequisite.

certifications.name: Certified Red Team Analyst (CRTA)
certifications.summary: Entry-level red team certification with a six-hour practical exam covering external and internal operations against an Active Directory environment.

certifications.name: Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator (ZDTA)
certifications.summary: Certification exam for administrators of the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange, taken at the end of the Zscaler for Users Administrator learning path.

certifications.name: Elastic Certified SIEM Analyst (Elastic SIEM Analyst)
certifications.summary: Exam for security analysts using Elastic Security, covering ECS, Discover, visualisations, detection rules, alerts, Timeline and Cases, completed with only the Elastic documentation as a reference.

certifications.name: Certified API Security Analyst (CASA)
certifications.summary: Exam of 100 multiple-choice questions in two hours on API security and the OWASP API Security Top 10, with an 80% pass mark.

certifications.name: API Security Certified Professional (ASCP)
certifications.summary: 12-hour practical exam in which the candidate performs a live penetration test of two API-driven applications.

certifications.name: Offensive Mobile Security Expert (OMSE)
certifications.summary: 48-hour practical exam with a final report covering advanced iOS and Android internals, ARM64 reverse engineering and mobile exploitation.

certifications.name: Chainalysis Digital Asset Fundamentals (DAF)
certifications.summary: Core blockchain concepts, digital asset mechanics and the UTXO and account-based models. Required before every other Chainalysis certification.

certifications.name: Chainalysis Certified Advanced Investigator (CCAI)
certifications.summary: Advanced investigator credential covering DeFi protocols, complex typologies, privacy networks and cross-chain tracing.

certifications.name: Chainalysis Certified Elite Investigator
certifications.summary: Top investigator tier covering privacy coins, mixer typologies, DeFi exploits and cross-chain tracing, ending in a practitioner capstone.

certifications.name: Chainalysis Certified Compliance Analyst
certifications.summary: Compliance-track credential covering AML/CTF, sanctions and digital asset risk frameworks for making defensible risk determinations.

certifications.name: Chainalysis Certified Compliance Specialist (Compliance Spec.)
certifications.summary: Senior compliance credential with deeper coverage of regulatory frameworks, typology analysis and risk programme design.

certifications.name: Chainalysis Asset Seizure Certification
certifications.summary: Covers the full lifecycle of crypto asset seizure, from identification and custody through legal documentation and disposition.

certifications.name: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
certifications.summary: Nine-course entry-level program covering security frameworks, network security, Linux, SQL, SIEM and IDS tools, incident detection and response, and Python automation. Course-based certificate assessed through quizzes, hands-on labs and portfolio activities, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: IBM Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate (IBM Analyst)
certifications.summary: Fourteen-course entry-level program covering security tools, operating systems, networking, databases, compliance frameworks, penetration testing, incident response and forensics, with a capstone. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and projects, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: Microsoft Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate (MS Cyber Analyst)
certifications.summary: Nine-course entry-level program covering networking and cloud basics, threat vectors, identity and access in Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender, SIEM and compliance, plus SC-900 exam preparation. Course-based certificate assessed through capstone projects, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architecture SC-100 Professional Certificate (MS SC-100 Arch)
certifications.summary: Five-course advanced program on security architecture: Zero Trust identity models, network segmentation, DevSecOps pipelines and cyber risk reporting, aligned to the SC-100 exam. Course-based certificate assessed through five portfolio projects, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Cybersecurity Professional Certificate (GCP Cyber)
certifications.summary: Five-course entry-level program on cloud security with Google Cloud: risk management, identity and access, threat detection, and incident response using tools such as Security Command Center. Course-based certificate assessed through hands-on labs, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: IBM Ethical Hacking with Open Source Tools Professional Certificate (IBM Eth Hacking)
certifications.summary: Six-course program on ethical hacking with Kali Linux, Metasploit, Wireshark and OpenVAS, covering reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, exploitation, reporting and incident response. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and projects, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: EC-Council Information Security Analyst Professional Certificate (EC-C ISA)
certifications.summary: Five-course entry-level program covering information security fundamentals, risk assessment, security operations, incident response and threat hunting. Course-based certificate assessed through hands-on labs and projects, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: IBM and ISC2 Cybersecurity Specialist Professional Certificate (IBM-ISC2 Spec)
certifications.summary: Twelve-course entry-level program from IBM and ISC2 covering security principles, access controls, network security, security operations and incident response, with preparation for the ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity exam. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and projects, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity Specialization (ISC2 CC Spec)
certifications.summary: Five-course ISC2 specialization covering security principles, incident response and business continuity, access control, network security and security operations, aligned to the Certified in Cybersecurity exam domains. Course-based certificate assessed through quizzes and case studies; the proctored CC exam is separate.

certifications.name: ISC2 Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP) Professional Certificate (ISC2 SSCP Prep)
certifications.summary: Seven-course ISC2 training program covering the SSCP domains, including access controls, security operations, risk identification, incident response, cryptography, and network and systems security. Course-based certificate assessed through knowledge checks and final assessments; the proctored SSCP exam is separate.

certifications.name: NYU Introduction to Cyber Security Specialization (NYU Intro Cyber)
certifications.summary: Four-course New York University specialization covering cyber attacks and risk analysis, authentication and cryptography, network security and firewalls, and enterprise security and compliance frameworks. Course-based certificate assessed through quizzes and projects, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: Cisco Cybersecurity Operations Fundamentals Specialization (Cisco CyberOps)
certifications.summary: Seven-course Cisco specialization covering security operations center basics, network and endpoint monitoring, attack analysis and incident handling for entry-level analysts. Course-based certificate assessed through quizzes, with no projects and no proctored exam.

certifications.name: Fortinet Network Security Specialization (Fortinet NetSec)
certifications.summary: Five-course Fortinet specialization covering the core Fortinet network security products and how to design, deploy, administer and support an enterprise security infrastructure with them. Course-based certificate with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: Infosec Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) Specialization (Infosec CISSP)
certifications.summary: Eight-course Infosec specialization reviewing the CISSP domains, with end-of-course assessments and a final practice exam. Course-based exam-preparation certificate; the proctored ISC2 CISSP exam is separate.

certifications.name: Infosec Python for Cybersecurity Specialization
certifications.summary: Five-course Infosec specialization on writing Python scripts to automate offensive and defensive security tasks, organised around MITRE ATT&CK and Shield use cases. Course-based certificate assessed through coding projects, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: University of Colorado Fundamentals of Computer Network Security Specialization (CU NetSec)
certifications.summary: Four-course University of Colorado System specialization covering secure system design, applied cryptography and PKI, penetration testing basics, and firewalls and intrusion detection. Course-based certificate assessed through projects on cloud instances, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: IBM Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate (IBM Analyst edX)
certifications.summary: Fourteen-course IBM program covering security tools, operating systems, networking, databases, compliance frameworks, penetration testing, incident response, and Security+ and CySA+ practice, with a capstone. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and projects, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: IBM Cybersecurity Fundamentals Professional Certificate (IBM Cyber Fund)
certifications.summary: Four-course IBM program covering cybersecurity tools and attacks, operating system security, compliance frameworks and database security. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and a final project, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: IBM Generative AI for Cybersecurity Professional Certificate (IBM GenAI Cyber)
certifications.summary: Three-course IBM program covering generative AI basics, prompt engineering and the use of generative AI in threat intelligence, behaviour analytics and incident reporting. Course-based certificate with hands-on exercises and no proctored exam.

certifications.name: RITx Cybersecurity MicroMasters Program (RITx MicroMasters)
certifications.summary: Four graduate-level courses from Rochester Institute of Technology: Cybersecurity Fundamentals, Computer Forensics, Cybersecurity Risk Management and Network Security. Course-based MicroMasters credential with no single proctored exam.

certifications.name: UMBC Principles of Cybersecurity MicroMasters Program (UMBC MicroMasters)
certifications.summary: Three courses from the University of Maryland Baltimore County (USMx) covering identity and access management, cryptography, network attacks, mobile, IoT and cloud security, digital forensics and governance. Course-based MicroMasters credential with no single proctored exam.

certifications.name: HarvardX Computer Science for Cybersecurity Professional Certificate (CS50 Cyber Cert)
certifications.summary: Two-course Harvard program combining CS50's Introduction to Computer Science with CS50's Introduction to Cybersecurity. Course-based certificate assessed through course assignments, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: HarvardX CS50's Introduction to Cybersecurity (CS50 Cyber)
certifications.summary: Single introductory Harvard course for technical and non-technical audiences covering passwords and authentication, phishing, malware, network attacks, encryption and privacy. Course-based verified certificate assessed through assignments, with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: EC-Council Cybersecurity Essentials Professional Certificate (EC-C Essentials)
certifications.summary: Three EC-Council courses: Network Defense Essentials (NDE), Ethical Hacking Essentials (EHE) and Digital Forensics Essentials (DFE), with add-on labs in the verified track. Course-based certificate; the edX page labels the courses intermediate.

certifications.name: Tel Aviv University Unlocking Information Security Professional Certificate (TAUx InfoSec)
certifications.summary: Two Tel Aviv University courses covering vulnerabilities and exploits, cryptography, buffer overflows, and network and web offense and defense. Course-based certificate with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: University of Wisconsin-Madison Cybersecurity Fundamentals for Small Organizations Professional Certificate (UW Small Org Sec)
certifications.summary: Three University of Wisconsin-Madison courses covering cybersecurity principles, data and information privacy, and cybersecurity planning and policy. Course-based certificate with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: Microsoft Security Engineer Professional Certificate (MS AZ-500 edX)
certifications.summary: Three Microsoft courses aligned to AZ-500 covering identity and access management, securing Azure networking, compute and storage, and managing security operations. Course-based certificate; the proctored AZ-500 exam is separate.

certifications.name: Microsoft SC-200 Security Operations Analyst Professional Certificate (MS SC-200 edX)
certifications.summary: Three Microsoft courses aligned to SC-200 covering threat mitigation with Microsoft Defender, SIEM and SOAR with Microsoft Sentinel, and data protection with Microsoft Purview. Course-based certificate; the proctored SC-200 exam is separate.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Google Security Operations Professional Certificate (Google SecOps)
certifications.summary: Three Google Cloud courses on the Google Security Operations (Chronicle) platform covering investigation, search, data ingestion, detections and modern security operations principles. Course-based certificate with no proctored exam.

certifications.name: Cellebrite Certified Physical Analyst for Inseyets (CCPA)
certifications.summary: Analysis of iOS and Android extractions with Inseyets Physical Analyzer, including SQLite database review, deleted data recovery and reporting. Earned by passing a knowledge test and a practical skills assessment (80% minimum); renewed every two years through a recertification exam.

certifications.name: Cellebrite Certified Mobile Examiner for Inseyets (CCME)
certifications.summary: Capstone certification of the Cellebrite mobile forensics track, requiring active CCO and CCPA certifications and completion of the Cellebrite Advanced Smartphone Analysis (CASA) course. Candidates must score 80% or above on both a time-limited practical skills assessment of two device examinations and a proctored 75-question knowledge exam, within 45 days of enrollment.

certifications.name: Certified Evidence Repair Technician - Forensic (CERT-F)
certifications.summary: Mobile device repair for forensic extraction, covering disassembly, micro-soldering and replacement of ports, screens and buttons. The course page states the credential is earned by passing a practical competency exam at the end of the 5-day in-person course.

certifications.name: GIAC Strategic OSINT Analyst (GSOA)
certifications.summary: Advanced OSINT certification covering collection at scale, analysis and media verification. Proctored exam of 82 questions in 3 hours that includes CyberLive hands-on items, passing score 66%.

certifications.name: Certified in Open Source Intelligence (C|OSINT)
certifications.summary: Board certification in open-source intelligence for investigators, earned by passing the course quizzes and a proctored final exam. Eligibility requires a degree or relevant paid professional experience.

certifications.name: Certified Social Media Intelligence Analyst (SMIA)
certifications.summary: Certification in social media intelligence and online investigations with an OSINT foundation module, assessed by a proctored board exam. Eligibility requires a degree or diploma plus relevant paid professional experience.

certifications.name: Open Source Intelligence Professional (OSIP)
certifications.summary: Practical certification in which the candidate receives a simulated client request and has 10 days to deliver an investigation case file, graded pass or fail against a professional standard. It does not expire.

certifications.name: Open-Source Certified (OSC)
certifications.summary: Vendor-neutral OSINT practitioner certification from the OSMOSIS Association with a proctored exam of 100 multiple-choice and true/false questions. Applicants document 75 hours of related experience in the previous year and sign an ethics statement; renewal needs 45 CPEs in three years.

certifications.name: Certified OSINT Professional (C|OSINT|P)
certifications.summary: Practical OSINT certification assessed through a 72-hour real-world investigation scenario followed by a written report of methods, findings and conclusions. The page states no expiry period.

certifications.name: Certified Offensive OSINT Operator (CO3)
certifications.summary: Offensive OSINT and reconnaissance certification for red teamers covering attack surface mapping, people and company profiling, OPSEC and automated pipelines. Earned by submitting at least 15 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: Social Links OSINT Certification Program Level 1 (OCP1)
certifications.summary: Vendor program on OSINT investigation with Social Links products in five modules (social media, messengers, niche platforms, advanced features, corporate sources), each followed by a test. The certificate is issued after all tests are passed and is valid for three years.

certifications.name: Basel LEARN Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) (Basel OSINT)
certifications.summary: Free self-paced OSINT course for financial and corruption investigators built around a simulated illegal fishing case that ends with an OSINT report. It awards a certificate of completion from the International Centre for Asset Recovery rather than an examined certification, and is widely used in the asset recovery and OSINT community.

certifications.name: OSINT Industries OSINT Training (OSINT Ind.)
certifications.summary: Practitioner-led OSINT training of about 18 hours over three days, built from modules such as OSINT Fundamentals, Advanced OSINT and OSINT for ICAC analysts. Course-based, with hands-on exercises; some courses end in an assessment such as a CTF or a quiz.

certifications.name: GIAC Machine Learning Engineer (GMLE)
certifications.summary: Covers data acquisition and manipulation, statistics, Python scripting, supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks and anomaly detection applied to security problems. One proctored exam of 82 questions in three hours with CyberLive tasks, passing score 65%.

certifications.name: GIAC AI Security Automation Engineer (GASAE)
certifications.summary: Covers automated asset discovery and incident response, Infrastructure as Code, Azure and AWS security automation, SOAR-driven SOC operations and AI concepts applied to detection and response. One proctored exam of 82 questions in three hours with CyberLive tasks, passing score 70%.

certifications.name: GIAC AI Platform Security (GAIPS)
certifications.summary: Covers generative AI concepts, tuning and aligning foundation models, securing agentic systems and AI integrations, AI application architecture, MLOps and MLSecOps, and AI risk management. One proctored exam of 54 questions in two hours, passing score 65%.

certifications.name: GIAC Certified Detection Analyst (GCDA)
certifications.summary: Covers SIEM fundamentals, service profiling, endpoint analytics, user behavior monitoring, cloud logging in AWS and Azure, and tactical SIEM detection. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 76%.

certifications.name: GIAC Experienced Forensics Examiner (GX-FE)
certifications.summary: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering application execution evidence, deleted artifact recovery, cloud storage, browser and USB activity and account usage on Windows systems. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.

certifications.name: GIAC Experienced Forensics Analyst (GX-FA)
certifications.summary: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering Windows file system artifacts, system triage, memory analysis, event analysis and enterprise threat hunting. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.

certifications.name: GIAC Battlefield Forensics and Acquisition (GBFA)
certifications.summary: Covers efficient data acquisition from a wide range of devices, manual identification and acquisition of data, and rapid production of actionable intelligence. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 69%.

certifications.name: GIAC Experienced Incident Handler (GX-IH)
certifications.summary: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering incident handling, attacker exploits, reconnaissance and analysis of attacks, infrastructure and vulnerabilities. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.

certifications.name: GIAC Enterprise Incident Response (GEIR)
certifications.summary: Covers incident response team coordination, enterprise detection and threat hunting, large-scale event correlation and timeline analysis, and artifact analysis across Windows, Linux, macOS, containers and cloud. One proctored exam of 82 questions in three hours with CyberLive tasks, passing score 72%.

certifications.name: GIAC Linux Incident Responder (GLIR)
certifications.summary: Covers Linux incident response, threat hunting and intrusion analysis, file systems, system triage, evidence collection, and user, application and timeline analysis. One proctored exam of 82 questions in three hours with CyberLive tasks, passing score 66%.

certifications.name: GIAC Advanced Smartphone Forensics (GASF)
certifications.summary: Covers mobile forensic examinations, device file system analysis, mobile application behavior, event artifact analysis and identification of mobile malware. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 69%.

certifications.name: GIAC iOS and macOS Examiner (GIME)
certifications.summary: Covers Mac and iOS file systems, system triage, application and user data, timeline analysis, and incident response, malware and intrusion analysis on Apple platforms. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 67%.

certifications.name: GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
certifications.summary: Covers traffic analysis and application protocols, the open-source IDS tools Snort and Zeek, and network traffic forensics and monitoring. One proctored exam of 106 questions in four hours with CyberLive tasks, passing score 67%.

certifications.name: GIAC Assessing and Auditing Wireless Networks (GAWN)
certifications.summary: Covers attacks on weak wireless encryption, 802.11 fuzzing, Bluetooth, RFID and NFC, rogue networks, software-defined radio, hotspots and WPA. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 70%.

certifications.name: GIAC Offensive AI Analyst (GOAA)
certifications.summary: Covers AI-assisted reconnaissance and OSINT automation, vulnerability discovery and exploit generation, malware development, bypassing security controls and guardrails, AI-driven phishing, and legal and OPSEC considerations. One proctored exam of 56 questions in two hours with CyberLive tasks, passing score 67%.

certifications.name: GIAC Critical Infrastructure Protection (GCIP)
certifications.summary: Covers NERC CIP standards and terms, BES cyber system identification and impact rating, implementation of supporting technologies and CIP program maintenance. One proctored exam of 75 questions in three hours, passing score 70%.

certifications.name: GIAC Security Leadership (GSLC)
certifications.summary: Covers building a security program that meets business needs, managing security operations and teams, and managing security projects and the program lifecycle. One proctored exam of 115 questions in three hours, passing score 70%.

certifications.name: GIAC Strategic Planning, Policy, and Leadership (GSTRT)
certifications.summary: Covers business and threat analysis, security programs and security policy, and leadership and communications. One proctored exam of 75 questions in three hours, passing score 76%.

certifications.name: GIAC Cyber Incident Leader (GCIL)
certifications.summary: Covers incident preparation, assessment, remediation and closure, building the incident management team and process, handling of different attack types, and incident tasks and communications. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 70%.

certifications.name: GIAC Defensible Security Architect (GDSA)
certifications.summary: Covers network-centric and data-centric strategies for a layered defense, assessment of existing technology to improve prevention, detection and response, and Zero Trust principles. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 63%.

certifications.name: GIAC Cloud Security Architecture and Design (GCAD)
certifications.summary: Covers cloud identity and access management, Zero Trust design, network architecture, data protection and centralized monitoring. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 63%.

certifications.name: GIAC Cloud Threat Detection (GCTD)
certifications.summary: Covers detection of attacks in the cloud, cloud investigations and cyber threat intelligence, and assessments and automation in AWS and Azure. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 70%.

certifications.name: GIAC Security Operations Manager (GSOM)
certifications.summary: Covers designing, planning and managing a SOC program, log collection priorities, alert use cases and response playbooks, and metrics and analytics to improve SOC operations. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 66%.

certifications.name: GIAC Experienced Cybersecurity Specialist (GX-CS)
certifications.summary: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering network security analysis, Windows and Linux security evaluation, security tools and common attacks and defenses. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.

certifications.name: GIAC Experienced Intrusion Analyst (GX-IA)
certifications.summary: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering protocol analysis of packet captures, network forensics and intrusion analysis with tools such as Wireshark, Scapy and IDS tooling. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.

certifications.name: Attacking and Securing CI/CD Pipeline Certification (ASCPC)
certifications.summary: Covers CI/CD pipeline exploitation, secret and credential abuse, artifact poisoning, OIDC and cloud identity abuse, container registry and Kubernetes delivery attacks, and pipeline hardening. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a lab followed by 48 hours to submit a report.

certifications.name: Offensive Azure Operations and Tactics Certification (OAOTC)
certifications.summary: Covers Azure and Entra ID enumeration, authentication and authorization attacks, RBAC and managed identity abuse, cloud lateral movement and persistence. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a live Azure environment followed by 48 hours to submit a report.

certifications.name: Offensive GCP Operations and Tactics Certification (OGOTC)
certifications.summary: Covers GCP IAM enumeration and abuse, service account compromise, metadata exploitation, GKE and container attacks, data exfiltration, persistence and lateral movement across projects. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a GCP lab followed by 48 hours to submit a report.

certifications.name: Entry-Level Penetration Tester Certification (ELPT)
certifications.summary: Entry-level penetration testing certification covering reconnaissance, internal networks, Active Directory, web and API testing, cloud, privilege escalation and reporting. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a scoped environment followed by 48 hours to write a penetration test report.

certifications.name: Advanced Red Team Operations Certification (ARTOC)
certifications.summary: Covers C2 operations with Cobalt Strike and Havoc, redirector and cloud infrastructure, Active Directory and AD CS exploitation, lateral movement, persistence and EDR evasion. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam requiring C2 deployment, target compromise and flags, followed by 48 hours to submit a report.

certifications.name: Offensive Development Practitioner Certification (ODPC)
certifications.summary: Covers development of custom offensive tooling such as shellcode loaders, reflective payloads and process injection, with AMSI and ETW bypass, API unhooking and EDR evasion. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a student-deployed AWS lab followed by 48 hours to submit a report.

certifications.name: Practical SOC Analyst Professional (PSAP)
certifications.summary: Intermediate threat hunting and incident response exam in which the candidate investigates a corporate network for three days and then has two days to write a report. No multiple-choice questions or flags; the certification does not expire.

certifications.name: Practical Web Pentest Expert (PWPE)
certifications.summary: Expert-level web application penetration test in which candidates must find and exploit chains of high or critical impact vulnerabilities over three days, then write a report in two days. Based on the Advanced Web Hacking course; the certification does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Security Operations Manager (CSOM)
certifications.summary: Security operations management certification covering SOC building, team and capability development, threat modelling, metrics and maturity assessment. Assessed by a hybrid exam with practical and theoretical parts; issued by Centri, the provider formerly named Security Blue Team.

certifications.name: TryHackMe Security Analyst Level 1 (SAL1)
certifications.summary: Entry-level security analyst certification covering computing foundations, cyber defence frameworks, threat detection, alert triage and case report writing. The exam combines multiple-choice questions with graded alert triage in a SOC simulator, completed within a 24-hour window.

certifications.name: TryHackMe Junior Penetration Tester (PT1)
certifications.summary: Entry-level practical penetration testing certification covering web application, network and Active Directory testing, privilege escalation and report writing. The exam is a simulated engagement completed within a 48-hour window with a client-style report.

certifications.name: CREST Practitioner Intrusion Analyst (CPIA)
certifications.summary: Entry-level closed-book exam of 120 multiple-choice questions in two hours on incident handling, network and host intrusion analysis and high-level malware analysis, pass mark 60%. A valid CPIA is required before sitting the CRIA.

certifications.name: CREST Registered Intrusion Analyst (CRIA)
certifications.summary: Intermediate invigilated exam of 150 multiple-choice questions in 2.5 hours on network intrusion, host intrusion and malware reverse engineering, taken at Pearson VUE centres with Kali Linux and Windows provided. Requires a valid CPIA.

certifications.name: CREST Certified Incident Manager (CCIM)
certifications.summary: Certified-level exam for incident response managers with a multiple-choice component and a written component of long-form and scenario questions, covering containment, evidence handling, communications, recovery and legal issues. Delivered in two parts at Pearson VUE, with part 2 taken within three months of part 1.

certifications.name: CREST Certified Tester - Application (CCT APP)
certifications.summary: Advanced certification with a three-hour written exam (multiple choice and written scenario) and a three-hour practical exam on web application testing. Accepted by the UK NCSC CHECK scheme.

certifications.name: CREST Certified Red Team Specialist (CCRTS)
certifications.summary: Advanced red team certification with a three-hour written exam (multiple choice and written scenario) and a three-hour practical exam covering a red team assault course and tradecraft and operational security. Formerly the CREST Certified Simulated Attack Specialist (CCSAS).

certifications.name: CREST Certified Red Team Manager (CCRTM)
certifications.summary: Advanced certification for those who lead red team engagements, with a three-hour multiple-choice and long-form exam and a three-hour scenario exam taken at selected Pearson VUE centres. Formerly the CREST Certified Simulated Attack Manager (CCSAM).

certifications.name: Certified Advanced Windows Forensic Examiner (CAWFE)
certifications.summary: Advanced Windows forensics certification with an open-book written test of 125 questions (up to eight hours, 80% to pass) and a practical exam on image files and Windows artifacts completed within 30 days. Recertification requires a proficiency exercise in the third year and 40 hours of continuing education.

certifications.name: IACIS Certified Mobile Device Examiner (ICMDE)
certifications.summary: Mobile device forensics certification with an open-book written exam and a practical exam on supplied image files, each with a 48-hour time limit and an 80% pass mark. Recertification requires a proficiency exercise and 40 hours of continuing education.

certifications.name: Investigating Windows Endpoints (IWE)
certifications.summary: Windows host forensics covering event logs, the registry, evidence of execution, persistence and lateral movement, NTFS, file recovery and timelining. Certification is earned by passing the course Knowledge Assessment, which has a multiple-choice part and a hands-on practical part; it does not expire.

certifications.name: Investigating Windows Memory (IWM)
certifications.summary: Windows memory forensics covering memory structures, acquisition, pagefile analysis and analysis with Volatility, MemProcFS and WinDbg. Certification is earned by passing the course Knowledge Assessment, which has a multiple-choice part and a hands-on practical part; it does not expire.

certifications.name: Investigating Linux Devices (ILD)
certifications.summary: Linux forensics covering log analysis, file systems, persistence mechanisms, memory forensics, live response, evidence collection and timelining. Certification is earned by passing the course Knowledge Assessment, which has a multiple-choice part and a hands-on practical part; it does not expire.

certifications.name: Investigating macOS Endpoints (IME)
certifications.summary: macOS forensics covering the Unified Logging System, HFS+ and APFS, core forensic artifacts, persistence mechanisms, evidence collection and timelining. Certification is earned by passing the course Knowledge Assessment, which has a multiple-choice part and a hands-on practical part; it does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Ethical Hacker (Practical) (CEH Practical)
certifications.summary: Six-hour proctored practical exam of 20 challenges on the iLabs Cyber Range, with a passing score of 60% to 85% depending on the exam form. No eligibility criteria; passing it in addition to the CEH knowledge exam gives CEH Master.

certifications.name: Certified Penetration Testing Engineer (C)PTE)
certifications.summary: Penetration testing certification assessed by a 100-question online exam with no course prerequisite. Sold as an unproctored standard exam or as a live-proctored ANAB-accredited version (C)PTE-A, two hours, 62% to pass, renewed every three years).

certifications.name: HackTricks AWS Red Team Expert (ARTE)
certifications.summary: Covers AWS identity and access management, encryption, networking protections and misconfigurations across more than 20 AWS services, with red team and whitebox methodologies. Certification requires passing a practical exam of lab challenges solved by submitting flags within 12 hours; no report is required.

certifications.name: HackTricks Azure Red Team Expert (AzRTE)
certifications.summary: Covers Azure and Entra ID identity management, access control abuse, encryption, networking security and exploitation of Azure services. Certification requires passing a practical exam of lab challenges solved by submitting flags within 12 hours; no report is required.

certifications.name: HackTricks GCP Red Team Expert (GRTE)
certifications.summary: Covers Google Cloud identity and access management, encryption, networking, misconfigurations across GCP services and pivoting between GCP and Google Workspace. Certification requires passing a practical exam of lab challenges solved by submitting flags within 12 hours; no report is required.

certifications.name: Certified Enterprise Security Professional - AD CS (CESP-ADCS)
certifications.summary: Covers Active Directory Certificate Services enumeration, certificate theft, privilege escalation through template and CA misconfigurations, persistence and forged certificates. Assessed by a 24-hour hands-on exam in a patched AD CS environment followed by a report; the renewal exam is free before expiry.

certifications.name: SANS Security Awareness Professional (SSAP)
certifications.summary: Credential for security awareness and human risk practitioners, aligned with the SANS LDR433 course. Open-book proctored exam of 50 questions in two hours with a passing score of 78% and no prerequisites.

certifications.name: Certified AppSec Pentesting eXpert (CAPenX)
certifications.summary: Seven-hour practical exam on advanced web application penetration testing, with flag-based challenges taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified API Pentester (C-APIPen)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on API penetration testing covering REST, SOAP and GraphQL flaws and the OWASP API Security Top 10, taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Desktop Application Pentester (CDAPen)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on desktop application penetration testing with flag-based challenges, taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Blue Teamer eXpert (CBTeamerX)
certifications.summary: Seven-hour practical exam in which candidates investigate a multi-stage intrusion across on-premises Active Directory and cloud environments and reconstruct the attack chain. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Network Security Practitioner (CNSP)
certifications.summary: Entry-level proctored multiple-choice exam on network security fundamentals, with factual and scenario-based questions. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Cloud Security Practitioner - AWS (CCSP-AWS)
certifications.summary: Entry-level proctored multiple-choice exam on AWS cloud security fundamentals, with factual and scenario-based questions. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Blue Team Practitioner (CBTP)
certifications.summary: Entry-level proctored multiple-choice exam on core blue team concepts, with factual and scenario-based questions. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Social Engineering Defense Practitioner (CSEDP)
certifications.summary: Entry-level proctored multiple-choice exam on social engineering attacks such as phishing, vishing and impersonation and on defending against them. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Blue Teamer (CBTeamer)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam in which candidates investigate a multi-stage intrusion in a Windows Active Directory enterprise and correlate artifacts across the attack lifecycle. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Mobile Pentester - Android (CMPen-Android)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on static and dynamic analysis of Android applications, using a supplied APK and flag-based challenges, taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Mobile Pentester - iOS (CMPen-iOS)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on static and dynamic analysis of iOS applications, using a supplied IPA and flag-based challenges, taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Red Teamer (CRTeamer)
certifications.summary: Five-hour practical exam on Windows red team operations, starting from low-privileged domain credentials and requiring privilege escalation and lateral movement. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Red Teamer eXpert (CRTeamerX)
certifications.summary: Seven-hour practical exam on stealthy red team operations in a detection-aware Windows enterprise, including multi-forest Active Directory abuse and evasion. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Active Directory Pentesting eXpert (C-ADPenX)
certifications.summary: Seven-hour practical exam on identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities across a simulated multi-forest Active Directory environment. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Binary Fuzzing & Reversing Professional (CBFRPro)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on binary fuzzing and reverse engineering, covering memory corruption bugs, disassembly and debugging, taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Kiosk Breakout Professional (CKBPro)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on breaking out of a locked-down Windows kiosk session over RDP and carrying out follow-on attacks. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified AI/ML Pentester (C-AI/MLPen)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on AI and machine learning security, focused on finding and exploiting weaknesses in LLM-based applications, taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Agentic AI Pentester (C-AgAIPen)
certifications.summary: Four-hour practical exam on penetration testing of agentic AI and generative AI applications, with flag-based challenges taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Cloud Pentesting eXpert - AWS (CCPenX-AWS)
certifications.summary: Seven-hour practical CTF-style exam on identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities in AWS cloud environments. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Certified Cloud Pentesting eXpert - Azure (CCPenX-Az)
certifications.summary: Seven-hour practical CTF-style exam simulating a complete attack chain in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: Web Red Team Analyst (Web-RTA)
certifications.summary: Entry-level web application security certification covering the OWASP Top 10 and common attack techniques. Earned by submitting at least 16 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: API Red Team Analyst (API-RTA)
certifications.summary: Entry-level API security certification covering reconnaissance, authentication flaws and business logic abuse. Earned by submitting at least 13 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: Azure Red Team Specialist (AzRTS)
certifications.summary: Red team certification for Microsoft Azure covering cloud identity attacks, misconfigurations and hybrid attack paths. Earned by submitting at least 15 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: AWS Cloud Red Team Specialist (CARTS)
certifications.summary: Red team certification for AWS covering attack surface enumeration, exploitation of misconfigured services and pivoting across VPCs. Earned by submitting at least 10 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Red Team Specialist (GCRTS)
certifications.summary: Red team certification for Google Cloud covering abuse of cloud services and adversary techniques mapped to MITRE ATT&CK Cloud. Earned by submitting at least 15 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: Hybrid Multi-Cloud Red Team Specialist (CHMRTS)
certifications.summary: Red team certification covering attacks across hybrid multi-cloud environments, including identity abuse and movement between on-premises and cloud infrastructure. Assessed by a 12-hour practical exam after a 30-day practice lab.

certifications.name: DevOps Red Team Analyst (DO-RTA)
certifications.summary: Offensive security certification for DevOps environments covering attacks on CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure misconfigurations. Earned by submitting at least 10 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: Kubernetes Red Team Analyst (K8s-RTA)
certifications.summary: Offensive Kubernetes security certification covering RBAC misconfigurations, service account abuse and privilege escalation to cluster compromise. Earned by submitting 10 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: Multi-Cloud Blue Team Analyst (MCBTA)
certifications.summary: Entry-level defensive certification for AWS, Azure and GCP covering cloud-native security controls, SIEM deployment and incident investigation. Earned by submitting at least 30 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: Red Team Specialist (CRTS V2)
certifications.summary: Red team certification covering end-to-end operations against Active Directory, AD CS, Exchange, SSO, MFA and VDI across segmented networks. Assessed by a 24-hour open-book practical exam after a 30-day practice lab.

certifications.name: Red Team Infra Developer (CRT-ID)
certifications.summary: Certification on building OPSEC-safe red team infrastructure, including cloud and on-premises C2, redirectors and payload servers. Assessed by a six-hour flag-based practical exam.

certifications.name: Active Directory Red Team Specialist (AD-RTS)
certifications.summary: Active Directory attack certification covering enterprise attack paths, AD CS, Exchange and virtualization infrastructure. Earned by submitting at least 24 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: Enterprise Lateral Movement Specialist (CELMS)
certifications.summary: Certification on lateral movement in enterprise networks through authentication abuse and remote management protocols. Assessed by a 24-hour practical exam followed by a report due within 24 hours, with a 75 percent pass mark.

certifications.name: Certified Windows Internals Red Team Operator (CWI-RTO)
certifications.summary: Certification on Windows internals for offensive work, covering Win32 and NT APIs, kernel data structures and debugging with WinDbg. Assessed by a task-based exam with no fixed end date, submitted as a PDF report.

certifications.name: Stealth Cyber Operator (CSCO)
certifications.summary: Advanced red team certification on stealth tradecraft, offensive infrastructure and endpoint security evasion in hardened enterprise environments. Assessed by a 72-hour practical challenge lab followed by a report due within 24 hours.

certifications.name: Certified Exploit Development Professional (CEDP)
certifications.summary: Exploit development certification covering stack-based vulnerabilities, memory corruption and debugging. Assessed by a task-based exam with no fixed end date, submitted as a PDF report.

certifications.name: Certified Red Team CredOps Infiltrator (CRT-COI)
certifications.summary: Short certification on credential access tradecraft used in authorized red team engagements. Assessed by a quiz-based exam that requires a 100 percent score.

certifications.name: Purple Team Analyst (CPTA V2)
certifications.summary: Purple team certification covering attack investigation, breach and attack simulation, threat hunting and detection validation across web, network, host and Active Directory. Assessed by a 24-hour flag-based practical exam after a 30-day practice lab.

certifications.name: Certified Offensive Phishing Operator (COPO)
certifications.summary: Certification on designing phishing operations, including phishing infrastructure and abuse of cloud identity and authentication flows. Earned by submitting at least 15 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

certifications.name: Certified AI Security Researcher (CAISR)
certifications.summary: 24-hour practical exam in a dedicated lab with LLM endpoints, RAG pipelines, MCP servers and agent systems, followed by 24 hours to submit a security research report.

certifications.name: Certified Android Malware Reverse Engineer (CAMRE)
certifications.summary: 24-hour practical exam on reverse engineering Android malware samples in a Corellium lab, assessed through a written report of findings and countermeasures.

certifications.name: Certified iOS Malware Reverse Engineer (CIMRE)
certifications.summary: 24-hour practical exam on reverse engineering iOS malware samples in a Corellium lab, assessed through a written report of findings and countermeasures.

certifications.name: Certified Mobile Malware Reverse Engineer (CMMRE)
certifications.summary: 48-hour practical exam on analysing and reverse engineering mobile malware on both iOS and Android in a Corellium lab, assessed through a written report.

certifications.name: Certified Mobile Security Engineer (CMSE)
certifications.summary: 48-hour practical exam on iOS and Android application security in a Corellium lab, assessed through a report reviewed by a panel.

certifications.name: Offensive ARM Exploitation Expert (OAEE)
certifications.summary: 48-hour practical exam on exploiting vulnerabilities in ARM target binaries and bypassing mitigations, assessed through a report of the analysis and working exploits.

certifications.name: Certified iOS Security Engineer (CISE)
certifications.summary: 24-hour practical exam on iOS application reverse engineering and exploitation in a Corellium lab, assessed through a report with working proof-of-concept binaries.

certifications.name: Certified Android Security Engineer (CASE)
certifications.summary: 24-hour practical exam on Android application reverse engineering and exploitation in a Corellium lab, assessed through a report with working proof-of-concept APKs.

certifications.name: Certified iOS Security Researcher (CISR)
certifications.summary: 24-hour practical exam on iOS internals, including sandboxing, Mach and XPC IPC, memory management and code signing, assessed through a report with working proofs of concept.

certifications.name: Certified Android Security Researcher (CASR)
certifications.summary: 24-hour practical exam on Android internals, including app sandboxing, SELinux, AOSP debugging and security mitigations, assessed through a report with working proof-of-concept scripts.

certifications.name: AI Red Teaming Professional Certification (AIRTP+)
certifications.summary: Hands-on online exam taken within a continuous 24-hour window, covering prompt injection, jailbreaking and defenses for LLM systems.

certifications.name: Certified Security Champion (CSC)
certifications.summary: Practical exam of five challenges to be solved in six hours, followed by 24 hours to submit a report, covering application and infrastructure security practices for security champions. Lifetime credential.

certifications.name: Certified DevSecOps Expert (CDE)
certifications.summary: Practical exam of five challenges to be solved in 24 hours, followed by 24 hours to submit a report, covering infrastructure hardening, compliance as code and vulnerability management at scale. Lifetime credential.

certifications.name: Certified Software Supply Chain Security Expert (CSSE)
certifications.summary: Practical exam of five challenges to be solved in six hours, followed by 24 hours to submit a report, covering software supply chain attacks and defenses across code, build and deployment. Lifetime credential.

certifications.name: Certified Threat Modeling Professional (CTMP)
certifications.summary: Practical exam of five challenges to be solved in six hours, followed by 24 hours to submit a report, covering threat modeling methodologies and their use in agile and DevOps teams. Lifetime credential.

certifications.name: CrowdStrike Certified Identity Specialist (CCIS)
certifications.summary: 90-minute, 60-question exam on Falcon Identity Protection, covering identity-based detections, policy rules, user risk and Zero Trust principles. Valid for three years.

certifications.name: CrowdStrike Certified Cloud Specialist (CCCS)
certifications.summary: 90-minute, 60-question exam on configuring and operating Falcon Cloud Security, covering cloud account registration, policies, runtime protection and detection analysis. Valid for three years.

certifications.name: CyberSec First Responder (CFR)
certifications.summary: 120-minute, 80-item multiple-choice and multiple-response exam (CFR-410) on threat detection, analysis and incident response. Valid for three years, renewed by continuing education or by retaking the exam.

certifications.name: Certified Internet of Things Security Practitioner (CIoTSP)
certifications.summary: 120-minute, 100-item multiple-choice and multiple-response exam (ITS-110) on securing IoT devices, networks, data, software and firmware. Valid for three years.

certifications.name: Certified Internet of Things Practitioner (CIoTP)
certifications.summary: 120-minute, 100-item multiple-choice and multiple-response exam (ITP-110) on IoT devices, connectivity, cloud platforms, data, security and privacy. Valid for three years.

certifications.name: Mandiant Cyber Threat Intelligence Analysis Certification (MCTIA)
certifications.summary: 60-minute online-proctored exam of 50 multiple-choice questions on threat intelligence analysis, with objectives based on the NICE work role AN-ASA-001. A score of 70 percent is required and three to five years of experience is recommended.

certifications.name: arcX Practitioner Threat Intelligence Analyst (PTIA)
certifications.summary: Awarded for passing the final arcX exam of the Cyber Threat Intelligence Practitioner course, a self-paced course of more than 25 hours built around the CREST CPTIA syllabus and the intelligence cycle.

certifications.name: Zscaler Zero Trust Cyber Associate (ZTCA)
certifications.summary: Entry-level certification on zero trust principles and architecture. Earned by completing a 5-hour self-paced course and a 120-minute exam of 75 questions, with up to three retests.

certifications.name: Zscaler Digital Transformation Engineer (ZDTE)
certifications.summary: Proctored 60-question multiple-choice exam at the end of the Zscaler for Users Engineer (EDU-202) path, covering identity integration, traffic forwarding, Private Service Edge, firewall, DLP, private app segmentation and digital experience monitoring. Recertification requires retaking the current exam.

certifications.name: Fellow of Information Privacy (FIP)
certifications.summary: Designation awarded on application to holders of a CIPP plus a CIPM, CIPT or AIGP who document three years of privacy or data protection experience, a personal statement and three peer references. There is no exam; it stays active while the underlying certifications are maintained.

certifications.name: EXIN Privacy & Data Protection Foundation (PDPF)
certifications.summary: Foundation exam on the GDPR: scope, principles and practice of data processing, international transfers and risk assessment. Closed-book, 40 multiple-choice questions in one hour with a 65% pass mark.

certifications.name: EXIN Privacy & Data Protection Professional (PDPP)
certifications.summary: Advanced-level GDPR certification on data protection policies, the roles of controller, processor and DPO, impact assessments and breach response. Requires accredited training with practical assignments and a two-hour exam of 40 multiple-choice questions with a 65% pass mark.

certifications.name: Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP)
certifications.summary: Data management certification aligned with the DAMA-DMBOK, offered at Associate, Practitioner and Master levels. Each online exam has 100 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes; the pass mark on the Fundamentals exam is 60% for Associate, 70% for Practitioner and 80% for Master.

certifications.name: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Security: Linux (EX415)
certifications.summary: Performance-based exam of four hours in which candidates analyse and implement security measures on several Red Hat Enterprise Linux systems. Red Hat expects RHCSA-level skills or equivalent experience.

certifications.name: PECB Certificate Holder in ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation (ISO 27001 F)
certifications.summary: Foundation certificate on the elements of an information security management system under ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Awarded after passing the PECB ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation exam; no prior experience is required.

certifications.name: PECB Certified ISO 31000 Lead Risk Manager (ISO 31000 LRM)
certifications.summary: Certification on establishing and running a risk management framework and process based on ISO 31000. Requires passing the PECB exam plus five years of professional experience, two of them in risk management, and 300 hours of risk management activities.

certifications.name: PECB Certified ISO/IEC 27005 Lead Risk Manager (ISO 27005 LRM)
certifications.summary: Certification on managing an information security risk management programme based on ISO/IEC 27005, including assessment methods such as OCTAVE, EBIOS and MEHARI. Requires passing the PECB exam plus five years of professional experience, two of them in information security risk management.

certifications.name: PECB Certified Lead Cybersecurity Manager (PECB LCM)
certifications.summary: Certification on implementing and managing a cybersecurity programme. Requires passing the PECB Certified Lead Cybersecurity Manager exam plus two years of cybersecurity experience and 300 hours of cybersecurity activities.

certifications.name: GRC Auditor (GRCA)
certifications.summary: Certification on auditing governance, risk and compliance capabilities. Online open-book exam of 100 scored multiple-choice questions in 120 minutes with a pass mark of 70; it renews yearly with the membership and 8 CPE credits from the second year.

certifications.name: Master Business Continuity Professional (MBCP)
certifications.summary: Highest DRI business continuity credential, requiring at least five years of experience across seven subject areas, seven essays with references and a pass of at least 75% on both the Qualifying Examination and the Master's Case Study Examination.

certifications.name: Associate Business Continuity Professional (ABCP)
certifications.summary: Entry-level DRI credential for people with less than two years of industry experience. Requires a pass of at least 75% on the DRI Qualifying Examination and no experience essays.

certifications.name: Certified Cyber Resilience Professional (CCRP)
certifications.summary: Credential combining cybersecurity and business continuity for resilience professionals. Requires more than two years of experience, essays on three of five elements (identify, protect, detect, respond, recover) and a pass of at least 75% on the Cyber Resilience Examination.

certifications.name: Certificate of the Business Continuity Institute (CBCI)
certifications.summary: Business continuity certificate based on the BCI Good Practice Guidelines 7.0 and its six professional practices. Online proctored closed-book exam of 90 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes with a pass mark of 63.

certifications.name: Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
certifications.summary: Internal audit certification earned by passing three exam parts (125 questions in 150 minutes, then 100 questions in 120 minutes each) and meeting degree and internal audit experience requirements. Holders attest to continuing education every year.

certifications.name: Certified Third Party Risk Professional (CTPRP)
certifications.summary: Third-party risk management certification requiring five years of experience in a related role. The remotely proctored exam has 120 multiple-choice scenario questions and a 70% pass mark; holders earn 36 CPE credits per three-year term.

certifications.name: Certified Third Party Risk Assessor (CTPRA)
certifications.summary: Certification for assessors of third-party IT risk controls, requiring five years of related experience and attendance at a live bootcamp. The remotely proctored exam has 120 multiple-choice scenario questions and a 70% pass mark.

certifications.name: HITRUST Certified CSF Practitioner (CCSFP)
certifications.summary: Credential for practitioners who work with the HITRUST framework and assessment process. Earned by completing the CCSFP course and passing its exam; it is kept through an annual refresher course, and the full course must be retaken after two refreshers.

certifications.name: FAIR Institute Certified Cyber Risk Professional (FAIR-CCRP)
certifications.summary: Cyber risk quantification credential requiring four FAIR courses (about 16 to 24 hours), a certification exam and three years of relevant experience. Valid for two years with 40 hours of continuing education.

certifications.name: ITIL 4 Practitioner: Information Security Management (ITIL4-ISM)
certifications.summary: Practice-level ITIL 4 certification on managing risks to the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information. Closed-book exam of 20 multiple-choice questions in 30 minutes with a 65% pass mark; accredited training or official eLearning is mandatory.

certifications.name: SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Associate (SP-IIQ-A)
certifications.summary: Proctored exam on IdentityIQ foundational concepts, applications, identity and access modelling, governance, user-driven requests and provisioning, as taught in the IdentityIQ Introduction and Essentials courses.

certifications.name: SailPoint Certified Identity Security Administrator (SP-ISA)
certifications.summary: Proctored role-based exam for administrators of Identity Security Cloud, covering the platform, virtual appliances, identity and lifecycle management, provisioning, access management, governance support and sources. Six months of hands-on experience is expected.

certifications.name: HashiCorp Vault Operations Advanced (formerly Vault Operations Professional) (Vault Ops Adv)
certifications.summary: Four-hour online proctored exam combining lab-based scenarios and multiple-choice questions on operating HashiCorp Vault in production. The Vault Associate certification is recommended but not required.

certifications.name: Fortinet NSE 7 in Secure Networking (NSE 7 SN)
certifications.summary: Earned by passing the proctored NSE 7 Secure Networking Architect exam while holding NSE 4 FortiOS and an NSE 5 or NSE 6 in Secure Networking. It replaces the FCSS Secure Networking title retired on 15 July 2026.

certifications.name: Fortinet NSE 7 in SASE (NSE 7 SASE)
certifications.summary: Earned by passing the proctored NSE 7 FortiSASE Architect exam while holding NSE 4 FortiOS and an NSE 5 or NSE 6 in SASE. It replaces the FCSS SASE title retired on 15 July 2026.

certifications.name: Fortinet NSE 8 Cybersecurity Expert
certifications.summary: Top Fortinet certification, formerly FCX. Requires NSE 4, an NSE 5 or NSE 6 and an NSE 7 in the same track, then the NSE 8 Core Practical Exam (on-site only) and one elective practical exam passed within a year.

certifications.name: Fortinet Industry Certification: OT Security (Fortinet OT)
