certifications.summary: Industry certification earned by passing the proctored OT Security Architect exam on top of prerequisite NSE certifications. It replaces the FCSS OT Security title retired on 15 July 2026.

certifications.name: F5 Certified Technology Specialist, BIG-IP LTM (F5-CTS LTM)
certifications.summary: Specialist certification on architecting, deploying, maintaining and troubleshooting BIG-IP Local Traffic Manager. Requires exams 301a and 301b, 90 minutes each, on top of the F5 Certified Administrator, BIG-IP.

certifications.name: F5 Certified Technology Specialist, BIG-IP ASM (F5-CTS ASM)
certifications.summary: Specialist certification on BIG-IP Application Security Manager, the F5 web application firewall. Requires the 90-minute exam 303 on top of the F5 Certified Administrator, BIG-IP, and leads to the Security Solutions Expert track.

certifications.name: Certified Wireless Network Expert (CWNE)
certifications.summary: Top CWNP credential awarded by board review, not by exam. Applicants must hold the CWNP professional certifications plus CWISA and one external networking certification, and submit essays, publications and three endorsements; renewal requires 60 continuing education credits.

certifications.name: Nozomi Networks Certified Engineer (NNCE)
certifications.summary: Certification on deploying and using Nozomi Networks Guardian for OT and IoT network monitoring. Timed online exam of 50 randomized questions in three hours, answered with the help of a dedicated lab environment.

certifications.name: Certified Protection Professional (CPP)
certifications.summary: Security management certification covering seven domains of security practice. The exam has 225 multiple-choice questions (200 scored) in four hours and requires five to seven years of security experience depending on degree; recertification needs 60 CPE credits every three years.

certifications.name: CERT Certificate in Cybersecurity Oversight (NACD Cyber-Risk Oversight Program) (NACD CERT)
certifications.summary: Online self-paced programme of about 16 hours for board directors on overseeing cyber risk, with a cyber-crisis simulation. Each module ends with an exam that needs 80% to pass, all within one year of registration; the certificate does not expire.

certifications.name: SABSA Chartered Security Architect, Practitioner Certificate (SCP)
certifications.summary: Practitioner level of SABSA, earned by SCF holders who attend one Advanced course (A1 to A5) and pass its exam module. The exam is a written assignment answering two of five questions within four weeks, dual-marked with a 75% pass mark.

certifications.name: SABSA Chartered Security Architect, Master Certificate (SCM)
certifications.summary: Master level of SABSA, earned by SCP holders who attend a second, different Advanced course, pass its written exam module and submit a master thesis that receives a pass.

certifications.name: Integrating Risk and Security Certification Credential (TOGAF IRS)
certifications.summary: Credential on integrating risk and security into a TOGAF enterprise architecture, with about three hours of learning. Earned by completing the learning units and passing the assessment bundled with accredited training or self-study; no prerequisites.

certifications.name: Tenable One Vulnerability Management Specialist (Tenable VM)
certifications.summary: Specialist certification for the Tenable One Vulnerability Management product. Requires a proctored written exam (60 multiple-choice questions, 120 minutes) and then a practical exam (up to 30 tasks, 240 minutes), each with an 80% pass mark; recertification repeats both exams.

certifications.name: Tenable Security Center Specialist (Tenable SC)
certifications.summary: Specialist certification for the Tenable Security Center product. Requires a proctored written exam (60 multiple-choice questions, 120 minutes) and then a practical exam (up to 30 tasks, 240 minutes), each with an 80% pass mark; recertification repeats both exams.

certifications.name: Tenable One OT Exposure Specialist (Tenable OT)
certifications.summary: Specialist certification for the Tenable One OT Exposure product. Requires a proctored written exam (60 multiple-choice questions, 120 minutes) and then a practical exam (up to 30 tasks, 240 minutes), each with an 80% pass mark; recertification repeats both exams.

certifications.name: InsightVM Certified Administrator (InsightVM Admin)
certifications.summary: Vendor certification for administrators of the Rapid7 InsightVM vulnerability management product. Online open-book exam of two hours with a passing score of 80%, awarded as a digital badge.
